title: Pure Qliphort
summary: Pure Qliphort EARTH Machine Pendulum and Tribute Summon control deck, commanded by Scale 9 Qliphort Scout and Scale 1 Qliphort Monolith. The archetype Normal Summons high-level Machine monsters without Tributing as Level 4 1800 ATK beatsticks whose stats reset under Skill Drain or Re-qliate, then tributes them for Qliphort Stealth and Qliphort Disk to trigger spell-speed removal while drawing massive cards with Monolith.

summary.title: Starters & Setup
points: Qliphort Scout: Core Normal Pendulum searcher paying 800 LP in the Pendulum Zone to add any Qli card from Deck to hand.
Summoner's Art: Zero-cost Normal Spell that directly adds Qliphort Scout or Qliphort Monolith from Deck to hand.
Saqlifice: Equip Spell granting +300 ATK, battle protection, treating the equipped monster as 2 Tributes, and searching Scout when sent to GY.
Performapal Trampolynx: Bounces Qliphort Scout back to your hand upon Pendulum Summon, allowing you to reactivate Scout's 800 LP search in the same turn.

summary.title: Opening Play
steps: Activate Summoner's Art to search Qliphort Scout from your Deck.
Place Qliphort Scout in the Pendulum Zone and pay 800 LP to search Saqlifice.
Normal Summon Qliphort Carrier without Tributing and equip it with Saqlifice.
Place Qliphort Monolith or Performapal Trampolynx in your other Pendulum Zone and Pendulum Summon Qliphort Helix from your hand.
Tribute Qliphort Carrier (treated as 2 Tributes via Saqlifice) to Tribute Summon Qliphort Stealth.
Chain Link 1 Qliphort Stealth bounces a card without allowing responses, Chain Link 2 Qliphort Carrier bounces a monster, and Saqlifice searches another Qli.
End your turn to resolve Qliphort Monolith, drawing 2 cards for the Tributed Qli monsters.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Qliphort Stealth: Spell Speed 4 boss that returns any card on the field to the hand upon Tribute Summon with zero opportunity for the opponent to respond.
Qliphort Disk: Tribute boss that Special Summons 2 Qli monsters directly from your Deck to fuel Link Summons or next-turn Tributes.
Qliphort Shell: Aggressive boss delivering piercing battle damage and attacking twice per Battle Phase.
Qliphort Genius: Link-2 Machine boss immune to Spells, Traps, and Link effects, negating face-up cards and searching high-Level Machines.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Re-qliate: Continuous Trap negating incoming monsters and banishing Level 5+ monsters on field while resetting your non-tribute Qlis to full ATK.
Skill Drain: Floodgate shutting down opposing monster effects while boosting your Normal Summoned Qlis from 1800 to 2400-2800 original ATK.
Saqlifice: Essential tribute doubler and search engine.
Laser Qlip: Grants an extra Normal Summon of a Qli monster each turn.

allow.Performapal Trampolynx: Scale 4 Level 2 Beast Pendulum: when you Pendulum Summon, targets Qliphort Scout in your other Pendulum Zone and returns it to your hand—allowing you to replay Qliphort Scout and activate its 800 LP search a second time in the same turn!
allow.Summoner's Art: Normal Spell that adds Level 5 Normal Pendulum Monster Qliphort Scout or Qliphort Monolith directly from your Deck to your hand with zero cost.
allow.Skill Drain: Limited to 1 in TCG: Continuous Trap that negates all Effect Monsters on the field while immediately resetting all of your non-Tribute Normal Summoned Qliphort monsters back to their full 2400–2800 original ATK!

main: Qliphort Scout
Core Scale 9 Level 5 EARTH Machine Normal Pendulum: pays 800 LP once per turn in the Pendulum Zone to add ANY 'Qli' card from your Deck to your hand.
Qliphort Monolith
Core Scale 1 Level 5 EARTH Machine Normal Pendulum: during the End Phase, if you Tributed a 'Qli' monster(s) this turn, draws cards equal to the number of 'Qli' monsters you Tributed!
Qliphort Stealth

Signature Level 8 EARTH Machine Pendulum boss (2800 ATK): can be Normal Summoned without Tributing; when Tribute Summoned, bounces 1 card on the field and your opponent CANNOT activate cards or effects in response!
Qliphort Disk
Level 7 EARTH Machine Pendulum boss (2800 ATK): when Tribute Summoned by Tributing a 'Qli' monster(s), Special Summons 2 'Qli' monsters directly from your Deck!
Qliphort Shell
Level 8 EARTH Machine Pendulum boss (2800 ATK): when Tribute Summoned, can make a second attack each Battle Phase and inflicts piercing battle damage.
Qliphort Carrier
Core Level 6 EARTH Machine Pendulum (2400 ATK): boosts Qlis by 300 ATK in the Pendulum Zone; can be Normal Summoned without Tributing; and bounces 1 monster on the field when Tributed!
Qliphort Helix
Core Level 6 EARTH Machine Pendulum (2400 ATK): weakens opponent's monsters by 300 ATK in the Pendulum Zone; can be Normal Summoned without Tributing; and destroys 1 Spell/Trap when Tributed!
Performapal Trampolynx
Scale 4 Pendulum that bounces Qliphort Scout back to your hand when you Pendulum Summon so Scout can activate its search effect a second time.
Saqlifice
Signature Equip Spell: gives the equipped monster +300 ATK, battle protection, treats it as 2 Tributes for a Qli, AND searches any Qli monster (Qliphort Scout!) when sent from field to GY!
Laser Qlip
Field Spell: grants an extra Normal Summon of a 'Qli' monster each turn, and Normal Summons of 'Qli' monsters cannot be negated.
Summoner's Art
Searches Qliphort Scout or Qliphort Monolith directly from your Deck.
Re-qliate

Archetypal Continuous Trap: negates effects of Level 4 or lower monsters on Summon for the turn; permanently negates Level 5+ monsters on Summon and banishes them when they leave the field, while resetting your non-Tribute Qlis to 2400–2800 ATK!
Qlife's End
Normal Trap that Special Summons itself as a Level 4 EARTH Machine (1800 ATK) that counts as 3 Tributes and protects your Qli cards from destruction this turn.
Skill Drain
Limited to 1 in TCG: negates all face-up Effect Monsters on the field while immediately boosting all your non-Tribute Normal Summoned Qli monsters to 2400–2800 ATK.
extra: Signature Link-2 EARTH Machine (2 Machine monsters): unaffected by Spell/Trap effects and activated effects of other Link Monsters; negates 1 face-up card on each field; and adds a Level 5+ Machine from Deck to hand when 2 monsters are Special Summoned to its zones!
